name: a_brand_resolution
description: Brand twins resolved by a decision model: the 120 highest fan-Jaccard pairs among the 2,000 most liked accepted brands, the pairs accepted as one brand, the exact fan counts of the merged brands and a trigram control over all 20,000 names.

relationship_type.instructions: Determine the exact catalog relationship between Brand A and Brand B, which share high behavioral fan overlap in a peer-to-peer marketplace.

criteria.same_entity_alias: Exact same brand, artist group, or company entered under two different names, abbreviations, acronyms, or historical rebrands (e.g., 'Tomorrow X Together' = 'TXT', 'A Bathing Ape' = 'Bape', 'Mugler' = 'Thierry Mugler', 'Dior' = 'Christian Dior', 'Good Smile' = 'Good Smile Company', 'Jeffree Star Cosmetics' = 'JSC')
criteria.sub_brand_or_diffusion_line: One is a direct sub-brand, diffusion line, or division of the other parent fashion/footwear brand (e.g., 'Victoria\'s Secret' and 'PINK', 'Free People' and 'We The Free', 'Nike' and 'Air Jordan'/'Jordan', 'NCT' and sub-unit 'NCT 127' or 'NCT Dream')
criteria.ip_franchise_and_owner_maker: One is a character IP / game / anime franchise and the other is its parent studio, publisher, or toy manufacturer (e.g., 'Hello Kitty'/'My Melody'/'Kuromi'/'Cinnamoroll' and 'Sanrio', 'Rilakkuma' and 'San-X', 'Yu-Gi-Oh!' and 'Konami', 'Pokemon' and 'Nintendo', 'Gundam' and 'Bandai')
criteria.distinct_co_liked_peers: Two distinct competing brands, separate music artists/groups, or sister characters that merely appeal to the same fan demographic (e.g., 'Ateez' vs 'Stray Kids', 'Panini' vs 'Topps', 'My Melody' vs 'Kuromi')

should_merge_brand_id.instructions: In a master brand catalog deduplication pipeline, should Brand A and Brand B be merged into a single canonical `brand_id` because they denote the exact same brand entity (acronym, abbreviation, spelling variant, or rebrand)?

criteria.true: Yes: Brand A and Brand B are synonymous names/abbreviations/rebrands for the exact same entity and splitting them is a catalog duplication bug
criteria.false: No: They are distinct brands, character vs parent company, parent vs sub-brand, or separate artists/characters

alignment_score.instructions: Rate the ontological equivalence between Brand A and Brand B.
criteria: 0 - Separate competing brands, separate musical artists, or distinct sister characters
1 - Franchise/character IP paired with its manufacturer or publisher (e.g., Hello Kitty & Sanrio)
2 - Parent brand paired with an official sub-brand, division, or group sub-unit (e.g., Victoria's Secret & PINK)
3 - Identical brand entity split across two catalog strings (e.g., TXT & Tomorrow X Together, Bape & A Bathing Ape)

sql.probe:
WITH fans AS (
  SELECT -(e.user_id + 1) AS src, CAST(i.brand_id AS BIGINT) AS dst
  FROM merrec_events e JOIN merrec_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id
  LEFT JOIN brand_ontology o ON o.brand_id = CAST(i.brand_id AS BIGINT)
  WHERE e.event_type = 'item_like' AND i.brand_id <> 0
    AND (o.brand_id IS NULL OR o.band = 'accept')
  GROUP BY e.user_id, i.brand_id
), top_brands AS (
  SELECT dst AS brand_id, COUNT(*) AS fans FROM fans GROUP BY dst ORDER BY fans DESC, dst LIMIT 2000
), brands AS (
  SELECT CAST(brand_id AS BIGINT) AS brand_id, MIN(brand_name) AS brand_name
  FROM merrec_items WHERE brand_id <> 0 GROUP BY brand_id
)
SELECT r.first AS brand_id_a, ba.brand_name AS brand_a,
       r.second AS brand_id_b, bb.brand_name AS brand_b,
       a.fans AS fans_a, b.fans AS fans_b, r.similarity AS jaccard
FROM cugraph_jaccard(
  edges => (SELECT src, dst FROM fans),
  vertex_pairs => (SELECT a.brand_id AS first, b.brand_id AS second
                   FROM top_brands a JOIN top_brands b ON a.brand_id < b.brand_id),
  directed => false
) r
JOIN top_brands a ON a.brand_id = r.first
JOIN top_brands b ON b.brand_id = r.second
JOIN brands ba ON ba.brand_id = r.first
JOIN brands bb ON bb.brand_id = r.second
ORDER BY r.similarity DESC, r.first, r.second
LIMIT 120
sql.context:
WITH target_items AS (
  SELECT CAST(brand_id AS BIGINT) AS brand_id, category_path, name, price
  FROM merrec_items
  WHERE brand_id IN ({brand_ids})
), stats AS (
  SELECT brand_id, COUNT(*) AS listings, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_price
  FROM target_items
  GROUP BY brand_id
), top_cat AS (
  SELECT brand_id, category_path,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY brand_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, category_path) AS rk
  FROM target_items
  WHERE category_path IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY brand_id, category_path
), sample_titles AS (
  SELECT brand_id, name,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY brand_id ORDER BY name) AS trk
  FROM target_items
  WHERE name IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT s.brand_id, s.listings, s.avg_price,
       MAX(CASE WHEN tc.rk = 1 THEN tc.category_path END) AS top_category,
       MAX(CASE WHEN tc.rk = 2 THEN tc.category_path END) AS second_category,
       MAX(CASE WHEN st.trk = 5 THEN st.name END) AS sample_1,
       MAX(CASE WHEN st.trk = 25 THEN st.name END) AS sample_2,
       MAX(CASE WHEN st.trk = 50 THEN st.name END) AS sample_3
FROM stats s
LEFT JOIN top_cat tc ON tc.brand_id = s.brand_id AND tc.rk <= 2
LEFT JOIN sample_titles st ON st.brand_id = s.brand_id AND st.trk IN (5, 25, 50)
GROUP BY s.brand_id, s.listings, s.avg_price
ORDER BY s.brand_id
sql.canonical:
SELECT vertex AS brand_id, component AS canonical_id
FROM cugraph_weakly_connected_components(
  edges => (SELECT brand_id_a AS src, brand_id_b AS dst FROM brand_pairs WHERE band = 'accept'),
  directed => false
)
ORDER BY canonical_id, brand_id
sql.dedup:
WITH likes AS (
  SELECT c.canonical_id, c.brand_id, e.user_id
  FROM merrec_events e
  JOIN merrec_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id
  JOIN brand_canonical c ON c.brand_id = CAST(i.brand_id AS BIGINT)
  WHERE e.event_type = 'item_like'
), member_fans AS (
  SELECT canonical_id, brand_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS fans
  FROM likes GROUP BY canonical_id, brand_id
), union_fans AS (
  SELECT canonical_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS exact_union_fans
  FROM likes GROUP BY canonical_id
), brands AS (
  SELECT CAST(brand_id AS BIGINT) AS brand_id, MIN(brand_name) AS brand_name
  FROM merrec_items WHERE brand_id <> 0 GROUP BY brand_id
)
SELECT m.canonical_id,
       MIN(cb.brand_name) AS canonical_name,
       COUNT(*) AS members,
       MAX(m.fans) AS primary_fans,
       SUM(m.fans) AS naive_sum_fans,
       MAX(u.exact_union_fans) AS exact_union_fans,
       ROUND(100.0 * (MAX(u.exact_union_fans) - MAX(m.fans)) / MAX(m.fans), 1) AS gain_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(m.fans) - MAX(u.exact_union_fans)) / SUM(m.fans), 1) AS double_count_pct
FROM member_fans m
JOIN union_fans u ON u.canonical_id = m.canonical_id
JOIN brands cb ON cb.brand_id = m.canonical_id
GROUP BY m.canonical_id
ORDER BY exact_union_fans DESC, m.canonical_id

trigram_control.normalization: NFKC, lowercase, punctuation deleted, pg_trgm word trigrams

full_pairwise_cost_estimate.basis: this run's backend calls; not executed
